importExport.title: Import / Export
importExport.subtitle: Import expenses from a CSV file or export them to open in Excel.

import.title: Import CSV
import.intro: Upload a CSV file with one expense per line. The first line holds the column names.
import.ruleAmount: Greater than zero, decimal comma or point (e.g. 12,34). Negative and zero values are rejected.
import.ruleDate: YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY. Month only (YYYY-MM or MM/YYYY) becomes day 1. Empty: day 1 of the default month.
import.ruleCategory: Category name (case and accents ignored). Created if it does not exist. Empty: Other.
import.ruleDescription: Free text. Empty: the category name is used.
import.formatNotes: Delimiter ; or , detected automatically. Portuguese headers (data, descricao, valor, categoria) also work. Up to 2 MB and 5000 lines.

preview.title: Preview
preview.invalidTitle: Rows that will not be imported
preview.duplicatesInfo: {count, plural, one {# expense already exists} other {# expenses already exist}} with the same date, amount and category. They will be imported anyway.
preview.duplicatesWarning: {count, plural, one {# expense already exists} other {# expenses already exist}} in the database with the same date, amount and category. Continue anyway?
preview.nothingToImport: There are no valid rows to import.
preview.inferredCategories: {count, plural, one {# row without a category will use} other {# rows without a category will use}} the category learned from your history.

result.title: Import complete
result.imported: {count, plural, one {# expense imported} other {# expenses imported}}.
result.skippedDuplicates: {count, plural, one {# duplicate skipped} other {# duplicates skipped}}.
result.skippedInvalid: {count, plural, one {# invalid row skipped} other {# invalid rows skipped}}.

export.title: Export CSV
export.intro: Download the expenses in a date range as a CSV that opens in Excel and can be re-imported.
export.invalidRange: The start date must be on or before the end date.
export.note: The CSV holds expenses only: recurring expense rules are not exported.
